corrected_value.title: Common single nucleotide polymorphisms in genes related to immune function and risk of papillary thyroid cancer.

decision.quote: In this independent and separate case–control study conducted in Germany, we replicated associations with PTC risk that we reported previously in SERPINA5 ( 21 ) and FTO ( 17 ) genes. Other candidate variants in EVPL , TICAM1 and SCARB1 previously identified ( 17 , 21 ) were also associated with PTC risk.
decision.reason: The German case-control study explicitly selected and empirically retested immune-function gene SNPs previously reported to be associated with PTC risk in reference 21 (Brenner A.V., et al., 2013, PLoS One, 8, e57243), specifically confirming PTC associations for SERPINA5 (rs2069974) as well as candidate variants in EVPL (rs2071194) and TICAM1 (rs8120) in Table 2 and the Discussion. corrected_value.authors: Riccucci, N. M., G. G. Van Ryzin, and H. Li.
corrected_value.title: Representative Bureaucracy and the Willingness to Coproduce: An Experimental Study.

decision.quote:
The purpose of this study is to conceptually replicate an earlier study by Riccucci,

Van Ryzin, and Li (2016), who examined the effects of representative bureaucracy on
the public’s willingness to participate with government in recycling. They found that

increased representation of women in the agencies responsible for recycling increased

the likelihood that women would recycle.
decision.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this work. The paper explicitly conducts a conceptual replication of the three-arm survey experiment by Riccucci, Van Ryzin, and Li (2016; Public Administration Review 76(1): 121–130, doi:10.1111/puar.12401), randomly varying the gender of four officials' first names across all-male, balanced, and all-female conditions in the emergency preparedness domain and comparing the resulting null OLS and logistic regression estimates against the original's positive female coproduction finding. The sole shipped row (input_row_index 2372, 10.1093/jopart/muu006) is Riccucci, Van Ryzin, and Lavena (2014), a distinct earlier 2x2 policing legitimacy experiment discussed only as background context.

corrected_value.title: The relationship between disgust sensitivity, anxiety and obsessions.

decision.quote:
The relationship between DS and OCI-R subscale scores was examined. Thorpe et al.
(2003) found that DS was correlated with all OCI distress subscales, though most powerfully
with the washing distress subscale. In the present study, DS was significantly related to scores
on the washing, ordering and hoarding subscales but not to the three other subscale scores of
neutralizing, checking and obsessing, although the latter two subtype scores were close to a
significant relationship to DS.
decision.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this work. (2003). decision.quote: Recent research on exercise with virtually present partners found that encouragement attenuated the Köhler effect, which boosts task motivation for weaker group members in conjunctive tasks.
